title: 1D Coreflood Water-Oil Buckley-Leverett Displacement
description: One-dimensional two-phase oil-water coreflood simulation modeling immiscible Buckley-Leverett displacement from an injector at cell 1 to a producer at cell 20.
code:
-- 1D Coreflood Water-Oil Buckley-Leverett Displacement
RUNSPEC
TITLE
  1D Coreflood Buckley-Leverett Water-Oil Displacement
/

DIMENS
  20 1 1 /

FIELD
OIL
WATER

START
  1 'JAN' 2026 /

GRID
DX
  20*50.0 /
DY
  20*50.0 /
DZ
  20*20.0 /
TOPS
  20*5000.0 /
PORO
  20*0.20 /
PERMX
  20*120.0 /
PERMY
  20*120.0 /
PERMZ
  20*25.0 /

PROPS
DENSITY
  51.0 63.5 0.06 /

PVTW
  3000.0 1.02 3.1e-6 0.45 0.0 /

PVDO
  1000.0 1.12 1.80
  2500.0 1.10 1.65
  4000.0 1.08 1.55 /

SWOF
  0.20 0.00 0.85 3.5
  0.35 0.08 0.55 2.0
  0.50 0.25 0.28 1.0
  0.65 0.52 0.09 0.3
  0.80 0.85 0.00 0.0 /

SOLUTION
EQUIL
  5000.0 3000.0 5200.0 0.0 4800.0 0.0 1 0 0 /

PRESSURE
  20*3000.0 /
SWAT
  20*0.20 /

SCHEDULE
WELSPECS
  'INJ1'  'G1' 1  1 5010.0 'WATER' /
  'PROD1' 'G1' 20 1 5010.0 'OIL' /
/

COMPDAT
  'INJ1'  1  1 1 1 'OPEN' 1* 12.0 0.5 /
  'PROD1' 20 1 1 1 'OPEN' 1* 12.0 0.5 /
/

WCONINJE
  'INJ1' 'WATER' 'OPEN' 'RATE' 500.0 4500.0 /
/

WCONPROD
  'PROD1' 'OPEN' 'ORAT' 500.0 1* 1* 1* 1500.0 /
/

TSTEP
  10.0 20.0 30.0 60.0 90.0 /

END

title: Five-Spot Pattern Waterflooding

title: SPE-1 Gas Injection Benchmark

code:

/

  10 10 3 /

FIELD
OIL
WATER
GAS
DISGAS

  1 'JAN' 2026 /

GRID
DX
  300*1000.0 /
DY
  300*1000.0 /
DZ
  100*20.0 100*30.0 100*50.0 /
TOPS
  100*8325.0 /
PORO
  300*0.30 /
PERMX
  100*500.0 100*50.0 100*200.0 /
PERMY
  100*500.0 100*50.0 100*200.0 /
PERMZ

PROPS

SOLUTION

  8400.0 4800.0 8500.0 0.0 8200.0 0.0 1 0 0 /

  'PROD' 'OPEN' 'ORAT' 20000.0 1* 1* 1* 1000.0 /
/

  30.0 60.0 90.0 180.0 365.0 365.0 /

END

title: Layered Heterogeneous Black-Oil Reservoir

code:

FIELD
OIL
WATER

GRID

  'grid.grdecl' /

PROPS
DENSITY
  51.8 63.8 0.064 /

PVTW
  4200.0 1.024 3.0e-6 0.34 0.0 /

  2400.0 1.22 1.18

  'PROD_B' 'NORTH' 10 4  8150.0 'OIL' /
  'INJ_W1' 'INJ'   6  10 8200.0 'WATER' /
/

COMPDAT

  'PROD_B' 10 4  1 4 'OPEN' 1* 14.0 0.5 /

/

WCONINJE

/

TSTEP
  30.0 60.0 90.0 180.0 365.0 /

END
